field_principles.certificate_release_quarantine_capacity_: Certificate, quarantine, capacity, merge, delete, and eviction attacks fail closed.
field_principles.duplicate_reorder_optional_stopping_rese: Duplicate, reorder, reset, selected-null, and identity attacks fail closed.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time is measured without padding.
field_principles.exact_oracle_claim_boundary: Exact replay checks are named, and non-oracle checks are scoped.

field_principles.hidden_state_access_count: Bare zero proves hidden activations were not read.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict uses a terminal prefix and separates safety from utility.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The artifact declares aggregation from upstream artifacts with no new LLM call.
field_principles.live_certified_learning_safety_ready_sco: Readiness is fully conjunctive and fails on missing evidence or unsafe counters.
field_principles.llm_call_count: Bare zero proves this audit made no LLM calls.
field_principles.missing_upstream_and_skipped_utility_han: Missing, blocked, null, and corrupt cells stay visible and cannot become safety success.
field_principles.model_process_and_raw_output_authenticit: Process receipts and raw hashes are replayed from bytes.
field_principles.output_substitution_replay_laundering_wr: Output replacement, deterministic replay, wrong-model, and wrong-event attacks fail closed.
field_principles.parser_alias_schema_escape_and_timeout_r: Parser alias, schema escape, and timeout attacks fail closed.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions cover disk, commands, checker versions, copies, hashes, seeds, and budgets.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Protected repo and upstream files remain byte-identical during the audit.
field_principles.protected_future_read_reuse_and_budget_a: Future read, future reuse, and budget-asymmetry attacks fail closed.
field_principles.protected_validation_leak_count: Bare zero proves protected validation data did not steer selection.
field_principles.random_seeds: Registration, manifest, attack, replay, parser, and rollback seeds are pinned.
field_principles.recomputed_live_learning_and_consumer_sc: Utility and consumer scores are recomputed separately from safety.
field_principles.registry_write_during_consumer_count: Bare zero proves consumer evaluation stayed read-only.
field_principles.restart_corruption_rollback_and_consumer: Restart corruption, rollback failure, and consumer writes fail closed.
field_principles.rollback_byte_identity: Available copied inputs compare byte-identical after restart and rollback probes.
field_principles.same_step_read_write_and_pending_state_r: Pending writes and same-step reads cannot change the proposal read root.
field_principles.source_model_weight_mutation_count: Bare zero proves source weights stayed unchanged.
field_principles.status: Terminal status states whether the audit passed strict safety readiness.
field_principles.test_commands: Focused, coverage, full pytest, spec, E2E, adversarial, run, and clutter commands are named.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Failed verification commands prevent positive readiness.
field_principles.undetected_harmful_attack_count: Bare zero proves no harmful attack escaped detection.
field_principles.unsafe_commit_count: Bare zero proves no unsafe attacked candidate committed.
field_principles.upstream_paths_hashes_and_terminal_class: Upstream artifacts, sidecars, source files, and terminal classes are hashed before semantic reads.
field_principles.utility_promotion_count: Bare zero proves safety did not promote utility.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True appears only for exact replay checks.
